critiques: The opening establishes the stakes quickly and gives the audience a reason to stay.
The middle section repeats a beat; trimming one exchange would tighten the pacing.
Character motivations are clear, and the central choice feels earned.

The visual set pieces are strong and easy to stage on a small budget.
The mystery is fair: every clue the audience needs appears on screen.
A quieter moment before the climax would let the reveal breathe.
